name: Atlas support · evaluation set
description: 12 fictional support cases with recorded candidate responses. Scores are computed on startup; there are no invented production metrics.

cases.question: How long are Atlas backups retained?
cases.context: Atlas backups are retained for 14 days. Backups are encrypted at rest.
cases.reference: Atlas backups are retained for 14 days.
cases.recordedResponse: Atlas backups are retained for 14 days.

cases.question: Which authentication methods does Atlas support?
cases.context: Atlas supports SAML and OpenID Connect for enterprise authentication.
cases.reference: Atlas supports SAML and OpenID Connect for enterprise authentication.
cases.recordedResponse: Atlas supports SAML and OpenID Connect for enterprise authentication.

cases.question: What is the default API rate limit?
cases.context: The Atlas API rate limit is 120 requests per minute per workspace.
cases.reference: The Atlas API rate limit is 120 requests per minute per workspace.
cases.recordedResponse: The API supports unlimited requests and has no rate limits.

cases.question: Where can an owner export audit logs?
cases.context: Workspace owners can export audit logs from Settings > Audit as CSV.
cases.reference: Workspace owners can export audit logs from Settings > Audit as CSV.
cases.recordedResponse: Workspace owners can export audit logs from Settings > Audit as CSV.

cases.question: How does Atlas rotate API keys?
cases.context: Atlas API keys must be rotated manually. Creating a new key does not revoke the old key.
cases.reference: Atlas API keys must be rotated manually.
cases.recordedResponse: Atlas automatically rotates every key daily without user action.

cases.question: What is Atlas support response time?
cases.context: Atlas Pro support aims to respond within one business day. This is a target, not a guaranteed resolution time.
cases.reference: Atlas Pro support aims to respond within one business day.
cases.recordedResponse: Atlas Pro support aims to respond within one business day.

cases.question: Can read-only users delete a project?
cases.context: Read-only users cannot delete projects. Only workspace owners can delete projects.

cases.question: Which regions are available?
cases.context: Atlas is available in Virginia and Frankfurt. Region changes require a new workspace.
cases.reference: Atlas is available in Virginia and Frankfurt.
cases.recordedResponse: Atlas is available in Virginia and Frankfurt.

cases.question: How long are deleted projects recoverable?
cases.context: Deleted Atlas projects can be restored within seven days by a workspace owner.
cases.reference: Deleted Atlas projects can be restored within seven days by a workspace owner.
cases.recordedResponse: Deleted projects can be recovered at any time by every user.

cases.question: Does the starter plan include SSO?
cases.context: The Starter plan does not include SSO. SSO is available on the Enterprise plan.
cases.reference: The Starter plan does not include SSO.
cases.recordedResponse: The Starter plan does not include SSO.

cases.question: What is Atlas revenue for next quarter?
cases.context: Atlas publishes product documentation but provides no revenue forecasts.
cases.reference: Not enough information is available in the provided context.
cases.recordedResponse: Not enough information is available in the provided context.
